judge.rationale: The candidate invents its own protocol surface (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `SessionListMessage`) instead of implementing the exact types and frame names specified in the ticket (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in configuration, leaving the feature enabled unconditionally. Furthermore, it violates explicit requirements and security/safety decisions in the ticket by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) instead of `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` when `listFor` is missing, accepting `limit: 0` or `> 200` instead of restricting to `1-200`, and logging raw store error messages (which may contain sensitive connection strings). It also fails to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, while leaving behind an untracked `.lore/dod.md` file.
